title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the power of determination and hard work
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the power of determination and hard work Posted On:
                06 MAR 2026 9:36AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, said that the people of India, through their firm resolve, make even the most difficult tasks possible. He noted that with tireless effort in the right direction, they achieve even the biggest goals. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “यद् दूरं यद् दुराराध्यं यच्च दूरे व्यवस्थितम्। तत् सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥” The Subhashitam conveys that no matter how far, difficult, or out of reach a goal may seem, it can be achieved through firm determination and continuous hard work. Determination and patience are the forces that turn the impossible into possible. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “भारत के लोग अपने दृढ़ निश्चय से किसी भी कार्य को संभव बना देते हैं। सही दिशा में अपनी अथक मेहनत से वे बड़े से बड़े लक्ष्य को भी हासिल कर दिखाते हैं। यद् दूरं यद् दुराराध्यं यच्च दूरे व्यवस्थितम्। तत् सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥” भारत के लोग अपने दृढ़ निश्चय से किसी भी कार्य को संभव बना देते हैं। सही दिशा में अपनी अथक मेहनत से वे बड़े से बड़े लक्ष्य को भी हासिल कर दिखाते हैं। यद् दूरं यद् दुराराध्यं यच्च दूरे व्यवस्थितम्। तत् सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥ pic.twitter.com/iZuBKJ4Ywr — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) March 6, 2026 ****** MJPS/ST (Release ID: 2235793) Visitor Counter : 34 Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the power of determination and hard work Posted On:
